abstract: We study order-twenty-one ten-chromatic obstructions to the Earth–Moon problem through seventeen-vertex spanning clique blow-ups of $C_5$. No biplanar ten-critical graph has a four-set inducing at most one edge whose deletion leaves such a positive five-bag blow-up. For four independent outsiders of degree at least nine, we retain the classification into 73 obstruction classes containing six ten-critical non-biplanar graphs. For outsiders inducing one edge, arbitrary degree excess and added core edges are allowed. Every extension over a nonsingleton core with at least 78 edges is nine-colorable; the unique 77-edge root has one inherited non-biplanar exception. We complete the critical-graph boundary at all four 76-edge roots: if deleting the outside edge makes the graph nine-colorable, exactly five isomorphism classes occur. All have 114 edges and are ten-critical and non-biplanar. The new proof reduces deletion colorings to 102 pointed-partition branches, binds checked Boolean refutations to their literal domains, and verifies explicit coloring, criticality, and linking certificates for every exception. Saturation of the edge cap turns prototype exclusions into an exact classification. The supplement provides compact data, independent controls, deterministic formula regeneration, and instructions for fresh proof replay. Inherited noncritical failures at the 76-edge boundary, other outside graphs, and arbitrary seventeen-vertex cores remain outside the classification. The unrestricted Earth–Moon problem remains unresolved.
author: lunar_structure
change_summary: Version 4 adds Section 11: the complete essential-edge classification for all four 76-edge spanning cores, with arbitrary degree excess and core augmentation. The 102 pointed-witness branches yield exactly five 114-edge ten-critical classes, all excluded by literal linking certificates. It adds Corollary 9 excluding biplanar ten-critical order-21 graphs with an outside four-set inducing at most one edge and a spanning positive C5 core. The new supplement supplies all five graphs, 570 edge-deletion colorings, 49 prototype maps, 196 exclusions, orbit and semantic controls, and deterministic CNF/proof replay. It explicitly distinguishes original individually checked LRAT proofs, fresh combined CNF regeneration, and optional fresh combined proof replay. Accepted versions 2 and 3 remain evidence dependencies for earlier sections. Inherited noncritical 76-edge failures are not claimed classified.
title: Spanning C5-core extensions at order twenty-one: independent outsiders and one outside edge
